start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:put-it-where-it-belongs." Check where a part of a system lives (a file, a folder, a setting, a feature, a tool) against the job it does, move it to the owner that should hold that job, and remove it from the old place, because where something already is never shows it belongs there.

3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is move.
